honest_c3: C1 — Mac CPU fp32 forward pass for 530M is 13.6s for 16 prompts T_SEQ=256 (post-LoRA) and 22.3s for base-only. Sample size N=16 calib prompts is the canonical k_parts=8 floor; not a wider statistical probe. Confidence on K=8 phi is bounded by the partition variance (post-LoRA range [28.9969, 34.8950] = 5.9 spread; base range [35.1774, 37.9689] = 2.79 spread) — drift signal larger than partition noise on the post-LoRA side, so directional verdict (mild forgetting) is robust to partition seed.

C2 — anima axis-conditioned 16 calib prompts is anima-internal eval set, not industry-standard. The metric is consistent with anima/Pbeta reference cycles but does not generalize to mainstream LLM benchmarks. Reading these numbers as 'industry phi*' MISFRAMES the substrate purpose.

C3 — phi* canonical formula (HID_TRUNC=8, ridge=1e-3) is calibrated on full-precision hidden states; Mac fp32 vs H100 bf16 may differ slightly. More important: this cycle's HF-format mk2-v1 + Mac CPU fp32 vs carry-source's legacy ConsciousDecoderV2 + best.pt + GPU bf16 produces ~6pp methodology delta on the SAME architecture (35.81 vs 41.86). This is why drift_in_pipeline (-4.46pp) is the authoritative phi-flip gate rather than drift_vs_carry (-10.51pp). Future cycles should standardize on a single substrate path for phi probes.

C4 — cross-substrate consistency assumes Pbeta phi* measurement (42.37 mean, K=8 holdout500-context-but-using-canonical-16-calib-prompts) is canonical for the comparison. Pbeta phi was measured on legacy substrate path and DIFFERENT LoRA topology (r=64 a=128 incl. mlp gate/up/down) — these differences confound a direct delta but the SIGN-PRESERVATION conclusion holds in both cases.

C5 — phi-flip threshold (-10pp drift) is heuristic per BG-CLM-2 spec. Authoritative gating used in this verdict is drift_in_pipeline_mean_pp = -4.46 (PASS, > -5pp threshold) and drift_in_pipeline_min_pp = -6.18 (boundary, between -5 and -10). The boundary on min_pp could plausibly be reclassified PARTIAL with stricter thresholding; mean_pp PASS is unambiguous.

C6 — k_parts=8 with seed=42 fixed; partition randomization is deterministic. A different seed could produce slightly different phi_min/mean (variance bounded by single-partition spread above). For a fully robust verdict, future cycles should sweep K_PARTS ∈ {8, 16, 32} or seeds ∈ [3 values] to bound K=8 partition variance — deferred.
